D: A selfish young emperor is turned into a llama and has to rely on a kind villager to get home.
P: Serve the spinach puffs when Kronk brings them out at dinner.
S: Puff pastry squares filled with spinach, feta and ricotta
Spinach wilted and squeezed dry, mixed with feta, ricotta, garlic and nutmeg, spooned onto puff pastry squares, folded, egg washed, baked at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed.
a nod to the mountain villages

Baby potatoes boiled and halved, covered in a creamy yellow chilli and feta huancaína sauce, topped with boiled egg, black olives and parsley. Boil 1kg baby potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, then halve. Boil 2 eggs for 10 minutes, peel and quarter. Blend 150g feta, 150ml evaporated milk, 2 tbsp aji amarillo paste, 4 crackers, 1 garlic clove and 2 tbsp oil until smooth and thick like custard. Arrange the potatoes on a platter, pour over the sauce and top with the eggs, sliced black olives and chopped parsley.
Quinoa with corn, black beans, tomato, red onion and cilantro in lime dressing
Quinoa rinsed and cooked, tossed with corn, black beans, tomato, red onion, coriander and a lime and cumin dressing.
M: Mudka's Meat Hut cheeseburger and chips
Grilled cheddar burgers with grilled onion and pickles, twice fried chips
Beef chuck patties grilled hot, cheddar and onion on toasted buns, with chips, the kind of special a jungle diner would sling.
Peruvian pollo a la brasa with green sauce
the emperor's dinner, without the poison

Whole chicken marinated in cumin, paprika, garlic, lime and soy, roasted until the skin is dark and crisp, with chips and a spicy green coriander sauce. Blend 5 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp dried oregano, 3 tbsp soy, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp oil. Rub over and under the skin of a 1.8kg butterflied chicken and marinate 4 hours. Roast at 220C for 45 to 50 minutes. Bake 800g frozen chips alongside. Blend a bunch of coriander, 2 green chillies, 60g feta, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, lime juice and a garlic clove for the sauce.
W: Dense chocolate cake with chocolate frosting
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar, flour and cocoa folded in, baked at 175C for 35 minutes, covered in chocolate fudge frosting and candles.
K: Peruvian purple corn drink simmered with pineapple peel and cinnamon, chilled
Purple corn simmered with pineapple peel, cinnamon and cloves, strained, sweetened, chilled with lime and diced apple.

prop.title: Mudka's Receipt
lines: Table for two, one is a llama

dishes.make_ahead: Fill and fold the puffs up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; egg wash and bake on the night

steps.text: Wilt the spinach and squeeze dry.
Mix with the feta, ricotta, garlic and nutmeg.
Cut the pastry into squares, spoon on the filling, fold and egg wash.
Bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Pull the lever.
Cook the quinoa and cool.
Toss with the corn, black beans, tomato, red onion and coriander.
Dress with lime juice, olive oil and cumin.

dishes.n: Mudka's Meat Hut cheeseburger and chips
dishes.make_ahead: Cut the chips up to 1 day ahead and keep them in cold water in the fridge, dried well before frying; shape the patties up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Fry the potato chips in the oil once at a gentle heat until soft, then again hot until crisp.
Shape the mince into patties and grill hot.
Melt the cheddar on top and grill the onion.
Serve on toasted buns with pickles. Special for two, or four.

veg.n: Mudka's Meat Hut black bean cheeseburger and chips
veg.make_ahead: Mash and shape the black bean patties up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; fry the chips and grill the patties on the night

steps.text: Fry the potato chips in the oil once at a gentle heat until soft, then again hot until crisp.
Mash the black beans roughly with the breadcrumbs, egg, cumin and smoked paprika and shape into 4 patties.
Cook the patties on a hot, lightly oiled grill plate until crusty on both sides.
Melt the cheddar on top and grill the onion.
Serve on toasted buns with pickles. Special for two, or four.
Melt the chocolate with most of the butter, whisk in the eggs and sugar and fold in the flour and some of the cocoa.
Bake at 175C for 35 minutes, then cool.
Beat the icing sugar with the rest of the cocoa and butter into a frosting.
Frost the cake and add candles.

ingredients.item: pineapple, peel only for the pot

steps.text: Put the purple corn, pineapple peel, cinnamon and cloves in a pot with the water.
Simmer for 45 minutes.
Strain, sweeten with sugar and chill.
Serve with lime juice and diced apple.

Mudka's Meat Hut cheeseburger and chips.veg: Grilled cheddar black bean burgers with grilled onion and pickles, twice fried chips

s.note: Puff pastry squares filled with spinach, feta and ricotta
s.how: Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and mix with 150g feta, 150g ricotta, a crushed garlic clove and nutmeg. Spoon onto 2 sheets puff pastry cut into squares, fold, egg wash and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Pull the lever.

s.note: Quinoa with corn, black beans, tomato, red onion and cilantro in lime dressing
s.how: Cook 200g quinoa and cool. Toss with 200g corn kernels, a drained tin of black beans, 2 diced tomatoes, red onion and coriander. Dress with lime juice, olive oil and 1 tsp cumin.

m.n: Mudka's Meat Hut cheeseburger and chips
m.note: Grilled cheddar burgers with grilled onion and pickles, twice fried chips
m.how: Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties and grill hot. Melt cheddar on top and serve on toasted buns with grilled onion and pickles. Fry 1kg potato chips twice. Special for two, or four.

w.note: Dense chocolate cake with chocolate frosting
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 200g butter, whisk in 4 eggs and 200g sugar and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 175C for 35 minutes. Frost with 300g icing sugar beaten with 40g cocoa and 80g butter, then add candles.

d.note: Peruvian purple corn drink simmered with pineapple peel and cinnamon, chilled
d.how: Simmer 250g purple corn with the peel of a pineapple, a cinnamon stick and 4 cloves in 2L water for 45 minutes. Strain, sweeten and chill. Serve with lime juice and diced apple.
